title: Whistler back to Vancouver, via Capilano
summary: Sea-to-Sky drive south from Whistler, a four-minute detour to Capilano, then hand back the car.
drive: Whistler to North Vancouver to Vancouver · 2h 00m · 126 km

segments.name: Segment 1 — Whistler village, last morning
segments.blurb: Short walk before checkout, no gondola this late in the season.

stops.name: Whistler Village Stroll
stops.note: Pedestrian village, shops and coffee before departure.

segments.name: Segment 2 — Sea-to-Sky Highway south
segments.blurb: Scenic descent with optional falls, mine, and provincial park stops.

stops.name: Murrin Provincial Park
stops.note: Small lake and cliffs, quick leg-stretch.

stops.name: Britannia Mine Museum
stops.note: Former copper mine, underground train tour.

stops.name: Porteau Cove
stops.note: Howe Sound viewpoint, popular photo stop.

segments.name: Segment 3 — Capilano Suspension Bridge
segments.blurb: Four-minute detour off the direct route into Vancouver.

map.to: Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, North Vancouver

stops.name: Cleveland Dam
stops.note: Nearby viewpoint over Capilano Lake, free.

segments.name: Segment 4 — Return car, settle into Mount Pleasant
segments.blurb: Drop the rental by 8pm, dinner near the Airbnb.

map.from: Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, North Vancouver

stops.name: Rental car return
stops.note: Must be back in Vancouver by 8:00pm — no car after this.

stops.name: Main Street, Mount Pleasant
stops.note: Dinner along Main St, walk from the Airbnb.
